$comment: Who may read and write each model of prisma/schema/files.prisma (rules: src/ownership.ts; roles: src/roles.ts). The office (and the worker and scheduler, in the tenant's system context) writes file rows through apps/factory-api's platform/files, always through command(). The partner role only reads, and only the files shared with it; the floor reads the files shared with its site and (W2b wave 14/16, QHS-189) adds the photos and voice notes of a maintenance request or job of its site, which the …_plant_care_w2b_guards trigger keeps to that: a PHOTO or AUDIO file of such a record, shared with the office and that floor, announced (PENDING_UPLOAD) and then confirmed, nothing else of any file: the floor key is floorSiteId (set exactly when visibility has FLOOR), the partner key is partyId (set exactly when visibility has PARTNER or LINK); the guard trigger of the …_files_guards migration keeps both consistent with visibility. Neither sees the legal hold, nor the scanner's version and finding (they see the scan state). No role deletes a row: a deleted file keeps its row in status DELETED, and the trigger refuses DELETE and TRUNCATE for every login. After a change run `npm run policies -w @nexus/factory-db -- <folder>`.

StoredFile.about: The office requests uploads, confirms them, shares files, sets retention and legal holds, and deletes files (status DELETED); the worker will add generated documents. A floor device reads the files shared with its site's floor, and adds and confirms the photos and voice notes of its site's maintenance requests and jobs (W2b, QHS-189; the trigger allows nothing else); a portal or link session reads the files shared with its party (the API also needs PARTNER for a portal session, and LINK and the link's record for a link).
